metadata.dc:description:
Official ADI Communications Technical Masterclass by Gary Pearce (25+ Years Hands-On Physical Security & Telecoms Engineer, Direct Mobile: 07860 244 274).
Why 850nm infrared night vision fails Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) court admissibility standards, how Hikvision ColorVu G2 F1.0 super-apertures capture 24/7 colour in pitch darkness, BS EN 62676-4 DORI identification targets (250 px/m), and solid copper Cat6 PoE cabling.
